title: Helicopter Helicopter
blurb: Fazlija recorded a Bosnian song called Helikopter and had no reasonable way of anticipating what TikTok would do with it. The chant is hypnotic in the most literal sense, since the repetition and the rhythm bypass whatever part of your brain is responsible for getting songs out again. It became the official soundtrack for rotation in all its forms — ceiling fans, figure skaters, office chairs, a life visibly spiralling. The parakofer parakofer is not an optional extra. It is the second rotor, and without it the whole thing falls out of the sky.
origin: From Fazlija's song 'Helikopter', viral as TikTok's spinning anthem.
